prediction_text: Direction: yes — he shall be rich, and by his own means without depending on marriage for subsistence. Wealth comes through his own trade/industry and favour/honour in his calling: Mars lord 2nd and of the Part of Fortune in the Ascendant brings money to him personally, Jupiter exalted and almost culminating in the 10th gives honourable advancement. Timing/continuance: Moon lady 10th applying to conjunction of Venus lady Ascendant, wanting 6°27', points to attainment over about 6-7 years (year scale, suited to a wealth question); it shall continue — cusp of 2nd fixed, Part of Fortune in a fixed sign in Mars's terms, so the estate is lasting, not transient.
basis: Venus lady Asc near Regulus; Mars lord 2nd and lord Part of Fortune in Asc near Spica 18 Libra; Jupiter in exaltation (Cancer) angular near 10th; Moon lady 10th separating sextile Mars/conj Mercury applying conj Venus wanting 6d27; fixed 2nd cusp and Part of Fortune in fixed sign. Lilly 2nd-house testimonies: angular exalted Jupiter + 2nd lord in Asc = wealth by own industry, fixed signs = continuance.
